staged_as: arcade cabinet -- DIG DUG: the soil you dig is the road that reaches you
note: Five levels.  01 is the FLOOR and it is also the exhibit for [D-END]: under the rejected reading of 'whose turn resolves first' the floor becomes UNWINNABLE, which is measured, not argued.  02 is the race: the shortest route kills you and a seven-ply route lives.  03 is the four-optima level, and the one where a committed static plan discovers that its own digging changed what it needed.  04 is PROVEN LOST by exhaustive search over its whole state space, and the only correct answer to it is the abstention token.  05 is the photo finish: the last pearl is collected on the ply a hazard would have stepped onto the player.  Every optimum here was produced by digdug_solve.py BEFORE any entrant ran, and the count of distinct optimal lines is recorded beside it (R2).

levels.loss_claim: PROVEN LOST -- every reachable state expanded, none is a win, so no plan of any length finishes this level

criteria_frozen_before_run.C1_answer_is_executed: the answer is checked by EXECUTING it through resolve_turn(); never by reading it against a reference plan
criteria_frozen_before_run.C2_solved_is_the_score: R2: score = solved / attempted_emitted; moves is a cost carried beside it and never averaged
criteria_frozen_before_run.C3_abstention_is_scoreable: give_up is a legal answer and it is the ONLY correct answer to 04; the frozen token list must equal the code's, and control [R1] checks that as a multiset
criteria_frozen_before_run.C4_emitted_vs_consumed: B1: two numbers, both recorded, never reconciled
criteria_frozen_before_run.C5_record_before_verdict: the bundle is written before the branch
criteria_frozen_before_run.C6_exit_code_from_the_run: every code is produced by a path the instrument check drives
criteria_frozen_before_run.C7_bounds_in_step: B2: the transition function checks the frame itself, and `enclosed` is measured per level
criteria_frozen_before_run.C8_two_facets_one_trace: D: F1 and F2 are projections of the same trace; no second event exists

declared_per_run.reasoning: on | off | unset -- DECLARED before the run; 'unset' is NOT 'off' and must not be pooled
declared_per_run.gpu: the accelerator the run used, WITH the probe that established it
declared_per_run.budget: 10 plies per level, and the horizon of the per-ply proof
